title: 040 Alchymie
prompt: Close-up of an alchemist's workbench where a plain steel longsword lies across an iron cradle, glowing bright blue alchemical liquid is poured over the blade from a flask held by a brass arm of an apparatus, the blade absorbs it and becomes enchanted: glowing blue runes appear along the steel, the edge shines brighter and sharper, blue sparks and vapour rise, flasks and copper tubes around. No people, no hands. Vibrant, highly saturated colours, glowing bright blue magic light dominates the image, copper and steel accents. No text.

title: 117 Pruzkum dolu
prompt: Wide shot at dusk of a mountainside with four different mine entrances carved into the rock, each glowing in a different colour: one sapphire blue, one blood red, one pale stone white and one bright orange, a continuous wooden mine cart track runs clearly from the foreground and branches into four tracks, each leading all the way into one of the entrances, a lookout path between them. No people. Palette: blue, red, white, orange glows against dark mountain rock and blue dusk sky. Vibrant, highly saturated colours, glowing bright blue magic light dominates the image. No text.
